verdict.rationale: rdrleakdiag.exe, a signed Windows diagnostic tool, was run with /p 668 /fullmemdmp against lsass.exe (PID 668), opened a remote thread in LSASS, and wrote minidump_668.dmp to the Desktop. This is a known LSASS credential-dumping technique (LOLBin abuse), and the Sysmon events show the full chain from process access to dump file creation.
